newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS BANK H1 NET PROFIT 14.3 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: HERMIS BANK H1 NET PROFIT 14.3 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's Hermis Bank said on Wednesday that its net profit for the first six months of this year was 14.3 million litas after it made a net profit for all of last year of 27.4 million litas.
The bank did not say if the figure was audited or unaudited and provided no comparative figure for the same period last year.

The bank, the second largest private commercial bank in the country, also said in a statement that its assets rose to 741.6 million litas from 533.6 million litas in the first six months of the year, an increase of 39 percent.
It added that its loan portfolio grew by 69.8 percent in the same period to 393.7 million litas.
It also said that its deposits rose by 37.3 percent to 542.4 million litas in the first half of 1997.
Individual deposits were 110 million litas, 2.3 times more than at the end of last year.
Hermis and rival Vilniaus Bank have both benefited from the flight to quality in Lithuania's banking sector, which has recovered from a crisis which broke at the end of 1995.
Hermis Bank is one of two banking shares on the Vilnius bourse's elite official list.
